question: Does the native GLOO two-hand positive contract work using separate left/right xr-sim squeeze bindings, without the former alias?
claim: Right-only squeeze leaves support disengaged. Left-only squeeze acquires and sustains support; moving only the left hand changes native aim by 25.94 degrees with head and right pose fixed. Left release restores one-handed aim within 0.0013 degrees.
method: Supersedes the alias limitation of receipts/20260914-twohand-native-grip.json. Actual injected Steam Prey, owned run run-20261004-103830 / PID113584, updated process-scoped x64 xr-sim ca14f5b (DLL SHA256 6be19cdbb5dae7b196f9deee4e28e6cfa8023fcd65242d526076032e28c5f25a); no xr-tape. Native reports plus per-hand runtime states and retained rendered captures. Offline reproduce: Python3.12 -E -B tools/re/verify_twohand_no_alias.py. Details in docs/TWO-HAND-NO-ALIAS-2026-10-04.md.

identity.reason: Steam module hash verified; launch manifest retains injected DLL hash/source checkpoint, isolated simulator file hash recorded.

instrument.reason: Native squeeze and held state agree with simulator per-hand grip states; actual primary pose and head fixed across acquisition, steering and release. Simulator error count zero.

control.reason: Near-foregrip neutral and right-only squeeze have fresh regionReady=1 but held=0. Positive left-only hold, left-only movement and release also retain fresh regionReady=1. Later negatives excluded due missing geometry.

scene.reason: Native Talos Lobby GLOO and supporting hand visible in retained left/right captures.

restore.reason: VR disabled and owned Prey PID closed normally; shutdown.txt confirms no running Prey. Isolated process runtime selection; shared runtime remains VDXR.

baseline.reason: Confirmed positive input/aim contract does not approve renderer baseline: retained captures still show the prior horizontal rendering band. No headset acceptance.

limits: GLOO only; first left-only attempt lost geometry and fresh rearm acquired sustained hold. Applied count is cumulative, not a contiguous frame duration. Late empty-air, held-return, reacquisition and inventory controls inconclusive because regionReady=0. No shots, physical controllers, other weapons, toggle/free-support preferences, xr-tape or headset comfort. Calibration UI and slot cards built after this native run were not tested live.
